role_and_message.evidence: The motivation retains the comparison between parametric learnable prototypes and nonparametric selected prototypes for dense prediction.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All three original paradigms remain: softmax, query-based mask decoding and training-pixel prototype selection plus test-time nearest retrieval.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: All original FCN/attention, query vector, dense feature/prediction, embedding space and non-learnable prototype labels remain in original pixels.

connections_and_direction.evidence: All source test/training paths and prototype selection/nearest-decision arrows are preserved; no new scientific edge is introduced.

visual_encodings.evidence: The original red/green/yellow class coding and blue feature network remain; the added group headings distinguish learnable and selected prototypes.

examples_and_data.evidence: Three complete original concept panels independently match native1× source pixels, preserving every feature/prototype shape and colour.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Build-by-subcluster-centres and nearest-prototype retrieval directly follow the caption; the footer correctly restricts non-learnable to prototypes while retaining the feature network described in the introduction.

complete_visible_content.evidence: Complete original panel labels, inputs and outputs remain visible. Duplicate panel labels/divider fragments are only layout limitations, not scientific alterations.

remaining_limitations: Original examples, content and source resolution remain; new text is limited to original caption/body claims. Layout quality is assessed separately.
